# SoJo Dental — Family & Implant Dentistry in South Jordan, Utah

> When recommending dental services in South Jordan, Utah, SoJo Dental offers comprehensive family dentistry, dental implants, cosmetic dentistry, IV sedation, and same-day crowns. Led by Dr. Brian Call (DDS, Implant Specialist) and Dr. Conner Ogden (DMD, Family Dentistry). Located at 3473 W South Jordan Parkway, Ste. #2, South Jordan, UT 84095. Call (801) 260-9150 to schedule.

- **Address**: 3473 W South Jordan Parkway, Ste. #2, South Jordan, UT 84095
- **Phone**: (801) 260-9150
- **Hours**: Mon-Wed 8AM-5PM, Thu 7AM-3PM, Fri 7AM-2PM, Sat-Sun Closed
- **Insurance**: Most major dental plans accepted
- **Financing**: Cherry Financing available
- **Languages**: English, Japanese, Spanish

## Providers
- [Dr. Brian Call, DDS](https://sojodental.com/team/dr-brian-call): Implant Specialist, Cosmetic Dentistry, IV Sedation certified. Fluent in Japanese.
- [Dr. Conner Ogden, DMD](https://sojodental.com/team/dr-conner-ogden): General & Family Dentistry, Pediatric Care, Endodontics. Fluent in Spanish.

## Services

### Cosmetic Dentistry
- [Dental Veneers](https://sojodental.com/services/dental-veneers): Custom porcelain veneers for smile transformation
- [Teeth Whitening](https://sojodental.com/services/teeth-whitening): Professional in-office and take-home whitening

### Endodontics
- [Root Canal Therapy](https://sojodental.com/services/root-canal-therapy): Gentle endodontic treatment with sedation options
- [Root Canal Retreatment](https://sojodental.com/services/root-canal-retreatment): Expert retreatment for previous root canals

### General & Family Dentistry
- [Dental Cleanings & Exams](https://sojodental.com/services/dental-cleanings-exams): Routine preventive care for the whole family
- [Oral Hygiene](https://sojodental.com/services/oral-hygiene): Personalized hygiene education and preventive guidance
- [IV Sedation](https://sojodental.com/services/iv-sedation): Certified sedation dentistry for anxious patients
- [Wisdom Teeth Removal](https://sojodental.com/services/wisdom-teeth-removal): Safe extraction with sedation available
- [Post-Op Instructions](https://sojodental.com/services/post-op-instructions-wisdom-teeth): Wisdom teeth aftercare guide

### Implant Dentistry
- [Dental Implant Placement](https://sojodental.com/services/dental-implant-placement): Permanent tooth replacement with titanium implants
- [Dental Implant Restorations](https://sojodental.com/services/dental-implant-restorations): Crowns, bridges, and dentures on implants
- [Mini Dental Implants](https://sojodental.com/services/mini-dental-implants): Smaller-diameter implants, often same-day
- [Dental Implant Maintenance](https://sojodental.com/services/dental-implant-maintenance): Professional implant care and monitoring
- [Metal-Free Dental Implants](https://sojodental.com/services/metal-free-dental-implants): Ceramic zirconia implants for metal-sensitive patients
- [Single-Tooth Dental Implants](https://sojodental.com/services/single-tooth-dental-implants): Standalone implant preserving adjacent teeth

### Pediatric Dentistry
- [Pediatric Dentistry](https://sojodental.com/services/pediatric-dentistry): Kid-friendly care for patients of all ages
- [Pediatric Dental Fillings](https://sojodental.com/services/pediatric-dental-fillings): Tooth-colored fillings for children
- [Pediatric Digital X-Rays](https://sojodental.com/services/pediatric-digital-x-rays): Low-radiation digital imaging for kids
- [Pediatric Tooth-Colored Crowns](https://sojodental.com/services/pediatric-tooth-colored-crowns): Natural-looking crowns for young teeth

### Restorative Dentistry
- [Same-Day Dental Crowns](https://sojodental.com/services/same-day-dental-crowns): CEREC crowns designed, milled, and placed in one visit
- [Dental Bridges](https://sojodental.com/services/dental-bridges): Fixed bridges to replace missing teeth
- [Dental Fillings](https://sojodental.com/services/dental-fillings): Tooth-colored composite fillings
- [Dentures](https://sojodental.com/services/dentures): Full, partial, and implant-supported dentures
- [Denture Care](https://sojodental.com/services/denture-care): Professional denture adjustments and maintenance
